text:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeMaps reporting intermittent 504s for streaming inference since ~10:32 PDT. Customer shows ~8% of streaming sessions failing with upstream timeout. Trace id from their header: tr_9b3f7c1a. Saw spike right after a small infra tweak. :warning:

jamal: On it. Do we have a sample request or curl they used? Any payload sizes or concurrency numbers?

maya: They shared this minimal repro (streaming chunks):
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" \n  -H \"X-Trace-Id: tr_9b3f7c1a\" \n  -d @payload.json \n  https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/stream
```
payload.json is ~7.5MB (many embedding vectors). They said they start 200 concurrent streams.

elena: Looking at ingress envoy logs for that trace window: repeated "upstream reset" and "HTTP/2 STREAM closed" errors. Snapshot at 10:31: h2_active_streams=540 (threshold=512), h2_outgoing_window low and stalls seen. Sample log: 
```
[10:31:12] envoy upstream reset: STREAM_RESET, downstream: IDLE -> CLOSED, trace=tr_9b3f7c1a
```

brad: Reminder — I pushed a keepalive/conn-config tweak at 10:29 to reduce idle windows. Could be correlated. ops-bot reported deploy ok.

jamal: Repro plan: run a scaled local test with long-lived streaming and 50 concurrent clients, each sending large payloads to mimic embeddings. Command I'm going to try: `wrk` + streaming script.

elena: Correlation looks strong. At 10:31 we show a burst of large-embedding requests from AcmeMaps IP range, many clients doing aggressive retries when their stream stalls — that churns HTTP/2 state and exhausts the connection-level window. Hypothesis: window exhaustion + client retries -> h2 stream stalls -> envoy returns 504 to downstream.

maya: For immediate mitigation I suggest: 1) scale up streaming ingress pool, 2) temporarily relax h2 window/streams limit, 3) put a per-customer streaming throttle (token-bucket) to limit concurrent long-lived streams. We can communicate temporary mitigations to the customer.

brad: I can revert the keepalive tweak and open a small hotfix to bump MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS to 1024 on the envoy cluster for the streaming frontdoor. If we revert keepalive it may increase memory but should reduce premature window closes.

jamal: I'm rolling a scale + throttle now: scaled streaming-pool by +25% and applied per-customer burst limit=50, rate=10r/s for the streaming route for AcmeMaps. Pushing change to edge via canary.

autoscaler-bot: autoscaler: added 6 instances to svc/ingress-streaming-pool (group: streaming-frontdoor).

elena: After scale + throttle the error rate dropped from ~8% -> 0.9% within ~4 minutes, traces now show fewer resets and normal window ACKs returning.

maya: Customer confirmed they see the stream stabilizing. Closing the immediate escalation.

brad: Follow-up actions (next sprint): add streaming-window metrics to dashboards, add alert for h2_active_streams > 80% capacity, formalize per-customer streaming QOS, and review keepalive tweak RFC. Filed ticket INC-9124 and RFC-1197.

maya: Assigning owners: elena -> h2 metrics + alert, jamal -> throttle QOS infra, brad -> keepalive RFC. I'll notify customer that we applied temporary throttle and will follow up with long-term changes. :white_check_mark:
